# Whats91 website content

> Whats91 explains WhatsApp messaging and ERP workflows for Indian businesses. Confirm current enabled features, account eligibility, integration prerequisites and written terms before launch. This optional entry file provides reading links; it does not establish provider designation, legal relationships or account access.

## Start here

- [Home workflow paths](/api/md/home)
- [Feature paths](/api/md/features)
- [Public website content catalogue](/api/mcp): GET, HEAD and OPTIONS; no MCP tool execution, account data or authorisation.
- [MCP access information](/mcp): July 20 source-reported availability; confirm current tools, provider, plan and account permissions before connecting.
- [MCP access Markdown](/api/md/mcp) and [MCP access passages](/api/mcp/pages/mcp).
- [Indexable canonical sitemap](/sitemap.xml) and [Article feed](/feed.xml). An available reader page can still have a temporary indexing hold.

## Buying and privacy conditions

[Pricing](/pricing) publishes the dated Meta INR schedule, recipient-market rates, marginal tiers, allowances and Whats91 pass-through terms. Its [Markdown](/api/md/pricing) and [public passages](/api/mcp/pages/pricing) derive from the same maintained pricing source. Platform fees, tax applicability, coin conversion and total payable require separate confirmed terms; [Partners](/partners) and [Whats91 Coins](/partners/whats91-coins) retain written-offer conditions.

[Four local tools](/tools) cover message-volume planning, user-assumption ROI, wa.me links and PNG QR generation. Calculations run in browser state; page requests and URL query links can reach the website. Copying uses clipboard permissions, and opening/sharing destinations transfers content. Avoid sensitive input. See [Privacy](/privacy) and [Cookies/preferences](/cookies) for site-level context; local processing does not establish no cookies, no transfers or whole-site privacy.

[Message examples](/whatsapp-templates) are illustrative, requiring account/category/approval review. [Eleven flow JSON examples](/chatbot-flows) span six categories; import and activation are unavailable here. No newsletter intake or subscriber delivery is enabled on the blog hub.

Support and availability follow the [contractual-only policy](/sla): staffed hours, signed commitments, named controls/providers/locations/retention and any certification or residency assurance require confirmation. [Terms](/terms), [Privacy](/privacy), and [Compliance](/compliance) explain scope; these links do not certify compliance.

## Company and recovery

[About](/about) provides company context subject to identity confirmation. [Careers](/careers) explains recruiting status; no current vacancy is established here. [Contact](/contact) accepts enquiries subject to its displayed receipt conditions. No parent-organization, individual-author, product roadmap or staffed-support promise is supplied by this entry file.

Alternate content uses flat keys. Unknown nested or flat keys return an error with current supported-key recovery. Missing bodies are unavailable rather than successful empty articles. HTML remains the canonical reader format; public alternate formats carry noindex headers.

- [WhatsApp API Cost Calculator](/tools/whatsapp-api-cost-calculator) — [Markdown](/api/md/whatsapp-api-cost-calculator), [public passages](/api/mcp/pages/whatsapp-api-cost-calculator).
